verses.en: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
verses.pt: Naqueles dias apareceu João, o Batista, pregando no deserto da Judéia,
verses.en_web: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And in those days John the Baptist came preaching in the waste land of Judaea,

verses.en: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.pt: dizendo: Arrependei-vos, porque é chegado o reino dos céus.
verses.en_web: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Let your hearts be turned from sin; for the kingdom of heaven is near.

verses.en: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.pt: Porque este é o anunciado pelo profeta Isaías, que diz: Voz do que clama no deserto; Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai as suas veredas.
verses.en_web: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.”
verses.en_bbe: For this is he of whom Isaiah the prophet said, The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight.

verses.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
verses.pt: Ora, João usava uma veste de pelos de camelo, e um cinto de couro em torno de seus lombos; e alimentava-se de gafanhotos e mel silvestre.
verses.en_web: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
verses.en_bbe: Now John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.

verses.en: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
verses.pt: Então iam ter com ele os de Jerusalém, de toda a Judéia, e de toda a circunvizinhança do Jordão,
verses.en_web: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jerusalem and all Judaea went out to him, and all the people from near Jordan;

verses.en: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.pt: e eram por ele batizados no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.
verses.en_web: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.en_bbe: And they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying openly that they had done wrong.

verses.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.pt: Mas, vendo ele muitos dos fariseus e dos saduceus que vinham ao seu batismo, disse-lhes: Raça de víboras, quem vos ensinou a fugir da ira vindoura?
verses.en_web: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.en_bbe: But when he saw a number of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, Offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?

verses.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.pt: Produzi, pois, frutos dignos de arrependimento,
verses.en_web: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
verses.en_bbe: Let your change of heart be seen in your works:

verses.en: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.pt: e não queirais dizer dentro de vós mesmos: Temos por pai a Abraão; porque eu vos digo que mesmo destas pedras Deus pode suscitar filhos a Abraão.
verses.en_web: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.
verses.en_bbe: And say not to yourselves, We have Abraham for our father; because I say to you that God is able from these stones to make children for Abraham.

verses.en: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.pt: E já está posto o machado á raiz das árvores; toda árvore, pois que não produz bom fruto, é cortada e lançada no fogo.
verses.en_web: “Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.
verses.en_bbe: And even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; every tree then which does not give good fruit is cut down, and put into the fire.

verses.en: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
verses.pt: Eu, na verdade, vos batizo em água, na base do arrependimento; mas aquele que vem após mim é mais poderoso do que eu, que nem sou digno de levar-lhe as alparcas; ele vos batizará no Espírito Santo, e em fogo.
verses.en_web: I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, I give baptism with water to those of you whose hearts are changed; but he who comes after me is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to take up: he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit and with fire:

verses.en: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verses.pt: A sua pá ele tem na mão, e limpará bem a sua eira; recolherá o seu trigo ao celeiro, mas queimará a palha em fogo inextinguível.
verses.en_web: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”
verses.en_bbe: In whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned up in the fire which will never be put out.

verses.en: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
verses.pt: Então veio Jesus da Galiléia ter com João, junto do Jordão, para ser batizado por ele.
verses.en_web: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus came from Galilee to John at the Jordan, to be given baptism by him.

verses.en: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.pt: Mas João o impedia, dizendo: Eu é que preciso ser batizado por ti, e tu vens a mim?
verses.en_web: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”
verses.en_bbe: But John would have kept him back, saying, It is I who have need of baptism from you, and do you come to me?

verses.en: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
verses.pt: Jesus, porém, lhe respondeu: Consente agora; porque assim nos convém cumprir toda a justiça. Então ele consentiu.
verses.en_web: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.
verses.en_bbe: But Jesus made answer, saying to him, Let it be so now: because so it is right for us to make righteousness complete. Then he gave him baptism.

verses.en: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
verses.pt: Batizado que foi Jesus, saiu logo da água; e eis que se lhe abriram os céus, e viu o Espírito Santo de Deus descendo como uma pomba e vindo sobre ele;
verses.en_web: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, having been given baptism, straight away went up from the water; and, the heavens opening, he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him as a dove;

verses.en: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.pt: e eis que uma voz dos céus dizia: Este é o meu Filho amado, em quem me comprazo.
verses.en_web: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
verses.en_bbe: And a voice came out of heaven, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.
